headline: Mark Zuckerberg to remain in California
standfirst: Meta secures its CEO's residency amid concerns over state tax changes.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Mark Zuckerberg has agreed to keep his home base in California despite new tax ballot measures.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Meta's board worried that if Zuckerberg moved, his focus on the company's AI goals would suffer.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The company created a new stock agreement to financially motivate him to stay put.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Keep an eye on how these new financial incentives impact Meta's AI development plans.

caption:
Mark Zuckerberg has reached a new agreement to stay in California as Meta works on AI projects.

Meta's board was concerned that a potential relocation by their CEO could disrupt their ambitious AI roadmap. To ensure stability, they have offered new stock incentives to keep him in the state.
